# ship-view

Your interface to the `view` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Commands

- [`view.patch_session`](references/docs/view.patch_session.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Patch a fragment in the caller's view session.
- [`view.append_session`](references/docs/view.append_session.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Append a fragment in the caller's view session.
- [`view.signal_session`](references/docs/view.signal_session.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Deliver a signal to the caller's view session.
- [`view.enter_edit_mode`](references/docs/view.enter_edit_mode.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Grant the session view-edit mode for a view.
- [`view.exit_edit_mode`](references/docs/view.exit_edit_mode.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Revoke the session's view-edit grant (idempotent).
- [`view.tool`](references/docs/view.tool.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — View-authoring tool dispatch for a session in view-edit mode.
